pages.lesson:
LESSON: NUMBER PUZZLE

Grade: PP1
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.6: Number puzzle

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Number puzzle. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify different parts of numerals • Demonstrate
2. use ICT to complete number • Learners complete number puzzles puzzles 1-9 using ICT

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: NUMBER PUZZLE
Number puzzle is a Grade mathematics skill used at school, at the market, and at home.

HOW TO STUDY THIS TOPIC
1. Read each idea slowly.
2. Copy every worked example into your book and recalculate it yourself.
3. Then try the practice questions without looking at the answers.

WORKED EXAMPLE STYLE
Write the question clearly. Show each step. Box the final answer.
Example framework:
  Question: (write a Number puzzle problem)
  Step 1: …
  Step 2: …
  Answer: …

KENYAN CONTEXT
Use shillings, market goods, school desks, or garden plots as story numbers so the maths feels real.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Solve one simple Number puzzle question using objects or a drawing.

Example 2: Solve a harder Number puzzle question showing every step.

Example 3: Make a word problem about Number puzzle set at a Kenyan market.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write and solve five questions on Number puzzle.
2. Explain one solution aloud to a parent or friend.
3. Invent one new word problem and solve it.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Complete 10 practice questions on Number puzzle in your exercise book.
2. Mark your work. Redo any question you missed.
3. Teach a younger learner one method from this lesson.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify different parts of numerals • Demonstrate
2. use ICT to complete number • Learners complete number puzzles puzzles 1-9 using ICT

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
